summary.ht: Haïti Standard rapòte Neil Latortue, ki te majistra Gonayiv nan moman an, anonse diskisyon ak otorite ak aktè lokal yo pou ede lekòl rekòmanse. Se yon atik achiv Janvye 2020.
summary.en: Haïti Standard reports that Neil Latortue, then mayor of Gonaïves, announced discussions with authorities and local actors to help schools reopen. This is a January 2020 archive report.

portrait-source-c491793b0b6857c0af38.original_title: La Mairie des Gonaïves annonce des dispositions favorables à la reprise des activités scolaires - Haiti Standard

title.ht: 2022: demann pou ranvwaye yon randevou pou reponn kesyon

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte Hervé Fourcand te mande pou ranvwaye randevou pakè Okay te fikse pou poze l kesyon apre sanksyon Kanada yo. Atik la dekri demann lan ak repons komisè gouvènman an nan moman sa a.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports Hervé Fourcand’s request to postpone questioning scheduled by the Cayes prosecutor after Canada’s sanctions. It describes the request and the prosecutor’s response at the time.

portrait-source-fba9e59106cf5fbbab46.original_title: Convoqué au Parquet des Cayes, Hervé Fourcand demande un report

title.ht: 2025: pozisyon sou Konstitisyon an ak ULCC
title.en: 2025: views on the Constitution and ULCC

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte Steven Benoît kritike avanpwojè nouvo Konstitisyon an epi li mande pou ULCC rete endepandan de enfliyans politik. Atik la prezante pozisyon li te bay nan emisyon Panel Magik.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports Steven Benoît’s criticism of the draft Constitution and his call for an ULCC independent of political influence. It describes views he expressed on Panel Magik.

portrait-source-e7324ef45edf556bae28.original_title: Steven Benoît rejette l’avant-projet de la nouvelle constitution et plaide pour une ULCC indépendante

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte Andy Marcelus prezante demisyon li kòm delege depatmantal Lwès pou patisipe nan pwochen eleksyon lejislatif yo. Atik la site lèt li te voye bay Premye minis la.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports Andy Marcelus’s resignation as departmental delegate for Ouest to participate in the coming legislative elections. The report cites his letter to the prime minister.

portrait-source-af0d27e0fa365fafad02.original_title: Haïti : Andy Marcelus démissionne de la délégation de l’Ouest pour se lancer en politique

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte enstalasyon doktè Boutroce Gally Pierre nan tèt direksyon depatmantal Sante Grandans lan. Atik la dekri seremoni Jeremi an ak objektif sèvis sante yo te anonse yo.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports Dr Boutroce Gally Pierre’s installation as departmental health director in Grand’Anse. It describes the Jérémie ceremony and the health-service aims announced there.

portrait-source-dedc8cfc0fd857cfa465.original_title: Le docteur Boutroce Gally Pierre installé à la Direction Départementale de la Santé Publique dans la Grand’Anse

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte enstalasyon doktè Dulaurier Jacques pou dirije kowòdinasyon biwo depatmantal OFATMA yo. Atik la dekri transfè responsablite a ak objektif kowòdinasyon sèvis yo.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports Dr Dulaurier Jacques’s installation to lead coordination of OFATMA’s departmental offices. It describes the handover and the stated aims for coordinating services.

portrait-source-a9022ab5996d549ebdd9.original_title: OFATMA : le Dr Dulaurier Jacques prend la tête de la DCDD

summary.ht: Rezo Nòdwès rapòte René Civil lanse pati Émergence Démocratique nan ane 2018. Atik achiv la prezante wòl li te genyen anvan sa ak mesaj li sou òganizasyon ak patisipasyon jèn.
summary.en: Rezo Nòdwès reports René Civil’s launch of Émergence Démocratique in 2018. This archive article describes his earlier role and his message on organisation and young people’s participation.

portrait-source-98ac0aed2f2d5eacbed4.original_title: René Civil lance un nouveau parti : « Émergence Démocratique »

title.ht: 2026: apèl sou aksè ak sèvis dyaliz
title.en: 2026: appeal on access to dialysis services

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte Robenson René voye yon lèt ouvè sou pri sèvis dyaliz nan lopital OFATMA Okay. Atik la prezante demann li pou otorite yo fasilite aksè pou fanmi nan Sid la.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports Robenson René’s open letter about the cost of dialysis services at the OFATMA hospital in Les Cayes. It presents his request for authorities to improve access for families in Sud.

portrait-source-ebd36f4e00f65bf39a35.original_title: OFATMA des Cayes : Robenson René alerte sur le coût élevé des séances de dialyse

summary.ht: Tèks opinyon sa a melanje refleksyon sou endepandans ak deklarasyon sou remèd tradisyonèl pandan pandemi COVID-19 la. Atik la pa bay prèv klinik pou deklarasyon sou tretman yo.
summary.en: This opinion piece links independence and traditional knowledge to COVID-19 remedy claims. The article provides no clinical evidence for its treatment claims.

portrait-source-e850f12c66e459959a17.original_title: Claudy Donet : Ayiti ka fè l ankò …

summary.ht: Nan tèks sa a, Josué Clermont prezante pozisyon li kòm kandida pou depite Okay/Ilavach nan epòk la. Li bay analiz li sou kriz politik la ak wòl eleksyon nan yon demokrasi.
summary.en: In this piece, Josué Clermont sets out his position as a Cayes/Ile-à-Vache deputy candidate at the time. He offers his analysis of the political crisis and elections’ role in a democracy.

portrait-source-3a68c3295a9b5a46816f.original_title: Épreuve historique et déchéance nationale! par Josué Clermont

summary.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte RHAJAC mande pou revoke Eno Zéphirin apre yon operasyon demolisyon nan Okap. Atik la prezante akizasyon òganizasyon an; li pa yon desizyon tribinal sou akizasyon sa yo.
summary.en: Vant Bèf Info reports RHAJAC’s demand for Eno Zéphirin’s removal following a demolition operation in Cap-Haïtien. The report presents the organisation’s allegations; it is not a court ruling on them.

portrait-source-45fb613119905411871a.original_title: Cap-Haïtien : le RHAJAC réclame la révocation du commissaire du gouvernement Me Eno Zéphirin pour abus d’autorité

title.ht: 2023: deklarasyon nan yon fowòm sou ensekirite
title.en: 2023: remarks at a forum on insecurity

summary.ht: Rezo Nòdwès rapòte deklarasyon Luc Occera nan yon fowòm sou ensekirite nan Latibonit. Atik la prezante akizasyon li te fè sou ansyen palmantè; li pa yon desizyon tribinal.
summary.en: Rezo Nòdwès reports Luc Occera’s remarks at a forum on insecurity in Artibonite. It presents accusations he made concerning former parliamentarians; it is not a court decision.

portrait-source-15454680fa3a587aa496.original_title: Financement des gangs dans l’Artibonite : Me Luc Occera dénonce 2 anciens parlementaires

title.ht: 2022: rapò sou anlèvman responsab SAM Ambulance
title.en: 2022: report on the SAM Ambulance head’s abduction

summary.ht: Nan atik Oktòb 2022 sa a, Rezo Nòdwès idantifye Ralph Sénécal kòm responsab SAM Ambulance epi li rapòte anlèvman li ak chofè li nan Ganthier.
summary.en: In this October 2022 report, Rezo Nòdwès identifies Ralph Sénécal as the head of SAM Ambulance and reports his and his driver’s abduction in Ganthier.

portrait-source-823968cf1d2c5982872d.original_title: Ralph Senecal, PDG de SAM ambulance, et son chauffeur kidnappés

title.ht: 2021: tèks opinyon sou Moïse Jean Charles
title.en: 2021: opinion piece about Moïse Jean Charles

summary.ht: Nan tèks opinyon sa a, Michélot Oxil eksprime sipò pou pakou politik Moïse Jean Charles pandan li pale de yon distenksyon inivèsitè. Se pozisyon otè a nan ane 2021.
summary.en: In this opinion piece, Michélot Oxil expresses support for Moïse Jean Charles’s political record while discussing a university honour. These are the author’s views in 2021.

portrait-source-183f4898c9d952d9ac6c.original_title: Oxil Michélot : »Au sommet de son art, Moïse Jean Charles récompensé par une université américaine »

title.en: Registration for the Gonaïves deputy race

summary.ht: PouSiOuPaTKonnen rapòte jounalis Johnny Ferdinand enskri pou pòs depite Gonayiv sou non SOLEY. Enskripsyon an pa vle di KEP valide kandidati a.
summary.en: PouSiOuPaTKonnen reports journalist Johnny Ferdinand’s registration for the Gonaïves deputy race under SOLEY. Registration does not establish CEP validation.

summary.ht: NAM-HAITI rapòte Denis Cadeau te rankontre sitwayen nan Miragwàn pandan yon toune MPH nan depatman Nip la. Atik la dekri prezantasyon pwojè pati a ak echanj sou eksperyans li nan Sena a.
summary.en: NAM-HAITI reports Denis Cadeau’s meeting with residents in Miragoâne during an MPH tour of Nippes. It describes the party’s presentation and discussion of his Senate experience.

summary.ht: TRiboLAND prezante patisipasyon MOSANOH nan gwoupman KAPAB nan Nòdwès. Atik la idantifye François Lucas Sainvil kòm responsab MOSANOH ak patisipan nan kous pou Sena a.
summary.en: TRiboLAND describes MOSANOH’s participation in the KAPAB grouping in Nord-Ouest. It identifies François Lucas Sainvil as MOSANOH’s leader and a participant in the Senate race.

title.ht: Dokiman Kanada sou sanksyon Novanm 2022 yo
title.en: Canadian briefing on the November 2022 sanctions

summary.ht: Dokiman ofisyèl sa a te prepare pou yon prezantasyon ki te prevwa devan yon komite an Fevriye 2023. Li site Hervé Fourcand pami moun Kanada te sanksyone nan Novanm 2022. Paj la te pibliye nan Septanm 2025.
summary.en: This official briefing, prepared for a February 2023 committee appearance, lists Hervé Fourcand among people Canada sanctioned in November 2022. The page was published in September 2025.
